data.one_liner: Resolves conflicts between iOS sliding back gestures and WillPopScope in Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Provides a custom PageTransitionsBuilder and PageRoute to allow smooth iOS-style swipe-to-back gestures while managing WillPop pop scopes properly. It can be applied globally via ThemeData or locally per route.
use_when: You have conflicts between iOS swipe back gestures and WillPopScope
You want custom page transitions that respect pop behavior
avoid_when: You do not need iOS-style navigation gestures
You are using a navigation framework that completely replaces standard Navigator routing
strengths: Solves a specific known Flutter routing issue (#14203)
Can be used globally via PageTransitionsTheme or locally with WillPopPageRoute
Supports multiple platforms like iOS, Android, and macOS
weaknesses: Limited documentation outside of the README
data.setup_notes: Override pageTransitionsTheme builders in your ThemeData or use WillPopPageRoute directly.
